content.caption: Success rate of MaTTS variants versus scaling factor k under parallel and sequential test-time scaling on WebArena-Shopping
content.description: Two-panel combined bar and line chart sharing a y-axis labeled Success Rate (SR), ranging from 36 to 56. The x-axis shows scaling factor k from 1 to 5. Panel (a) is Parallel Scaling and panel (b) is Sequential Scaling. Gray bars show MaTTS w/o memory, a dashed light-blue line with diamond markers shows MaTTS w/o aggregation, and a solid dark-blue line with circle markers shows MaTTS. In both panels, full MaTTS rises steadily: from 49.7 to 55.1 in parallel scaling and from 49.7 to 54.5 in sequential scaling. The variant without aggregation peaks at k=4 (52.9 parallel, 52.4 sequential) and then dips slightly at k=5. The variant without memory stays far lower, around 37–42. It rises gradually in parallel scaling but fluctuates in sequential scaling.
